column1: The build quality is excellent and it feels sturdy after daily use.
My delivery arrived three days late and tracking did not update.
Setup was simple, and the instructions were easy to follow.
The monthly price is too high for the features included.
Support replied quickly and solved my account issue on the first try.
The app crashes whenever I open the order history.
It works as expected. The packaging was fine and delivery was on time.
The product looks great, but one accessory was missing from the box.
Battery life is excellent and performance has been reliable so far.
Checkout was confusing and I could not find the shipping options.
Customer service was polite, but I had to contact them twice.
Good value for money; the product arrived in perfect condition.
The latest update made the app slower and harder to use.
The replacement part arrived quickly and fit perfectly.
Average experience overall. It does the job, nothing more.
